topics.name: component quality
topics.description: The physical production: cards, miniatures, boards, tokens, dice and the box insert.

topics.name: rules and learning curve
topics.description: How easy the game is to learn and teach: rulebook clarity, player aids and first-game confusion.

topics.name: difficulty and balance
topics.description: How hard the game is to win, how much luck decides outcomes and whether the heroes are evenly matched.

topics.name: art and graphic design
topics.description: Illustrations, iconography and how readable the text and symbols are.

topics.name: replayability and variety
topics.description: How much variety the scenarios, events and heroes offer over many plays.

topics.name: setup and play time
topics.description: How long setup, teardown and a full game take.

topics.name: theme and story
topics.description: The setting, narrative and how strongly the game makes players feel part of its world.

topics.name: player count scaling
topics.description: How the game changes between two, three, four or more players at the table.

topics.name: solo play
topics.description: Playing the game alone, including the one-player rules and how well they work.

expected.outcome: ideal; any deviation is a measurement of the real providers, not a harness failure

topics.name: component quality
topics.description: Physical quality of miniatures, cards, tokens, boards, dice and other bits, including defects, damage and missing or misprinted parts.

topics.name: rulebook and learning
topics.description: How clear, well organised or confusing the rulebook, reference aids, FAQ and teaching process are, including learning curve and rules errors.

topics.name: art and visual design
topics.description: Illustration, art style, graphic design and readability of icons, text and fonts on the board and cards.

topics.name: difficulty and balance
topics.description: Challenge level, luck versus choice, fairness of losses, difficulty options and hero balance.

topics.name: setup and storage
topics.description: Time and effort to set up and pack away the game, plus inserts, organisers and storage solutions.

topics.name: replay value and variety
topics.description: Whether scenarios, events, heroes and campaign branching stay fresh or become repetitive over many plays.

topics.name: player count performance
topics.description: How the game plays at different numbers of players, from two to five, and scaling issues.

topics.name: theme and story
topics.description: Narrative, lore, setting, world-building and how well the theme connects to the mechanics.

topics.name: price and fulfilment
topics.description: Cost, value for money, crowdfunding, shipping, delivery delays, editions and availability.

topics.name: solo play
topics.description: Experiences and questions about playing alone, including the solo mode, automa and one-player variants.

topics.name: video content feedback
topics.description: Comments about the review video itself, such as filming, requested coverage and suggestions for follow-ups.

method.providerLabel: Two-phase topics (Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 (topic-discovery-v2) → consolidation (topic-consolidation-v3) + TypeSafe jev-latest (jev-topic-a1), batches of ≤ 25)
